# Frozen test/build configuration and command lifecycle

config-materialization.v1.json maps exact supplied TOML/JSON bytes to runtime paths. pytest testpaths are ["tests", "../authoring-tests"]. TypeScript test config includes src, test, test-red, tools and test-harness; harness config explicitly includes test-harness, durability and security sources. Production build excludes test, test-red, test-harness and tools. Baseline root/extension package manifests remain pinned unless a task explicitly declares an approved change.

MIG0-T05 installs the copied baseline frozen offline dependencies before the P01 focused checks. P01 creates stubs/configs; MIG0-T07 refreshes native locks, reinstalls frozen offline environments and compiles harness output before P03. P05-T09 compiles all tests and executes security/release/seal qualification. P06 verification-topology checks collection/build inventory for materialization, contracts, durability, clock, review, security, release, seal, bootstrap, authoring and test-harness. No omitted suite is inferred from bare pytest.

Build products extension/.test-build and extension/dist are generated by registered compilers. P07 binds their source-to-output inventory. The zero-parent delivery includes qualified test JS separately from production dist so a read-only reviewer need not recompile the sealed source. Runtime environments/caches are never exported. Review scratch environments are independently installed offline from the same frozen dependencies. Missing cached dependencies yield HOLD, not a provider/network call.

Candidate replay registry is an explicit allowlist in verification-topology.v1.json. Every command has a owner/consumer relation in command-io.v1.json. Metadata available_at describes file readiness, not an instruction to execute future operations. Executable-reference checks are static for later side-effectful operations; future seal, host-key creation and review launches are not executed as candidate tests.

Post-commit replay uses baseline-replay-command-registry.v1.json: every candidate runtime verification argv is retained, with cwd explicitly changed to the final runtime root. The replay runner cannot use authoring cwd or execute itself. P08 baseline tests receive the pinned normative pack candidate read-only while final pack assembly is still pending; runtime identity is measured from the actual final Git repository. Tests must accept explicit runtime/pack roots and must not infer a root from a spoofed environment. After seal, the final pack replaces the equal normative candidate input.

P09 assembles the exact delivery-map.v1.json authoring-source exports and copies CANDIDATE proof evidence before hashing. In sealed-review mode the reference checker resolves historical authoring-only source through those read-only pack exports; it never mounts the authoring workspace. Runtime sources resolve in final runtime. Build/environment caches are excluded from delivery except the specifically qualified test JS and dist inventories.

MIG0-T07 emits only sources selected by tsconfig.harness.json. P03-T02 implements the child, then executes COMPILE_CRASH_HARNESS_AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION before its focused Chrome check; P03-T03 consumes that refreshed JS. P04-T03 compiles the complete test config after clock implementation. P05-T09 repeats the complete compile after all security/release source changes. Generated-output ownership names each compiler writer. Every test consumer checks source/config-to-output freshness; the existence of old JS never suffices. TEST_SECURITY_TS enumerates all six owned compiled security files as separate argv operands; it does not pass a directory.

P08 baseline replay argv replaces authoring/runtime operands with final runtime and replaces the authoring/pack normative input with a provisional final-pack projection at the final review-pack path. P09 replaces that projection with the officially assembled pack containing the same normative bytes plus the new baseline receipt before hashing and sealing. This exact argv is frozen by MIG0-T08, not interpolated at execution. Its receipt binds the actual final Git identity and the exact normative-source-map source-set digest (paths, sizes, SHA256 in UTF8 order), excluding receipts/evidence/seal outputs. P09 proves the delivered mapped normative set is equal. A_CHECK_BASELINE --check-only recomputes final identity and that equal set from final pack without executing historical P08 argv or accessing authoring. P05-T09 TEST_RELEASE_TOOLS lists only P05-owned test files; P06 tests execute at P06 and candidate replay.

The source-owned `docs/configs/full-verifier-controller.v1.json` is the only P07 controller input binding. It names the exact current checkout, governed pack, external authoring tests and tools plus their closed delivery-map content root, offline caches, Chrome binary plus SHA-256, evidence root, and receipt paths. P07 validates every input before execution, creates command evidence first, then creates and revalidates the candidate receipt; a candidate receipt is never a prerequisite to the command that generates it. The candidate inventory is the clean Git-controlled checkout at its exact HEAD and tree, excluding only generated or ignored scratch outside the tracked source set. Missing, dirty, stale, aliased, or unconsumed bindings yield HOLD or FAIL, never guessed defaults.

COMPILE_PRODUCTION at P05-T09 runs tsc -p tsconfig.build.json. Each declared extension/src/*.ts emission has one owned dist/*.js path (same relative path below src); ambient declaration files emit nothing. Candidate/baseline replay include the compiler. Production exclusion qualification runs only after this output exists and verifies exact inventory, import closure and absence of test privileges.

P08-T03 executes BASELINE_INSTALL_PYTHON and BASELINE_INSTALL_NODE in the actual final runtime before replay, with frozen offline native installers and scripts disabled. They create only ignored .venv and root/extension node_modules and cannot alter tracked source/locks; record actual dependency projection and before/after tracked identity. Absence or corruption of cache is HOLD. P08-T01 exports the content-addressed P07 working-tree inventory, not the initial authoring Git HEAD; every included uncommitted file must have an accepted owner and exact qualified hash. P08-T02 stages exactly this export, including the specifically enumerated ignored test-build/dist files, while excluding all dependency/cache trees. The zero-parent commit must cover those exact bytes. No intermediate authoring commit is needed.
